governance_rule: Strictly linear operational gating. No state may transition directly from pre-capture readiness to validation without physical data collection, post-capture quality validation, and blinded human adjudication.

states.description: Protocol and engineering specifications finalized; facility selected; hardware procurement complete.
Sensors, PTP Grandmaster, rigid rigging, and network switches physically mounted on site.
Active hardware burn-in, intrinsic/extrinsic optical calibration, PTP clock lock, CAN bus decoding, and secondary zone field target tests underway.
All pre-capture gates C1 through C6 verified PASS. Instrumentation certified capable of capturing data. GT and Model Validation remain NOT_ESTABLISHED.
Active execution of controlled trial matrix (L01-L09) or naturalistic recording session under Safety Marshal oversight.
Emergency stop or data integrity violation triggered during capture session; raw data isolated and tagged ABORTED.
Physical trial run or naturalistic recording concluded nominally; data locked on encrypted storage.
Post-capture gates D1 through D6 verified PASS; sanitized review packages compiled with zero model scores or AI annotations; ready for human adjudicators.
Double-blind human panel adjudication complete; adjudication schema validated; Ground Truth established for the field dataset.

transitions.trigger: Hardware or mounting failure during commissioning requiring physical remount
Any trigger in abort_criteria.json (E-stop, zone breach, clock unlock, packet drop)

prerequisites: No abort conditions tripped during run duration
Ground Truth dataset committed with cryptographic provenance

forbidden_transitions.rule: CRITICAL_VIOLATION: Cannot leapfrog physical capture, data quality verification, and human Ground Truth establishment.
CRITICAL_VIOLATION: Calibration and test artifacts cannot be reviewed as operational dataset.
CRITICAL_VIOLATION: Raw unadjudicated captures cannot establish validation without sanitized human GT review.
